Changelog

Source: NEWS.md

msarima 0.0.0.9006

  • New sacf() and spacf(), autocorrelation and partial autocorrelation plots that highlight the lags of each seasonal cycle, with the periods taken from an msts object or from a fitted model. ggsacf() and ggspacf() are the ggplot2 versions.

  • New vignette msarima, a walk-through of the package on MAD_m40.

  • New dataset MAD_m40: hourly traffic volume on the M-40 ring road of Madrid, February to May 2024, as an msts object with seasonal periods 24 and 168.

  • Fixed estimation of models with differencing in msarima(). The differencing operator was folded into the AR polynomial and the conditional sum of squares was computed on the undifferenced series, padded with a constant. The first d + sum(D * S) residuals were therefore start-up transient (they entered the likelihood and biased the estimates), and residuals() had the same length as the input series. The series is now differenced before estimation, so fitting msarima(x, order = c(p, 0, q), seasonal = list(c(0, 1, 1))) gives exactly the same coefficients and residuals as fitting the same ARMA on diff(x, S). residuals() and fitted() are now NA for the first d + sum(D * S) observations (fitted values remain on the scale of the original series).

  • forecast.msarima() and simulate.msarima() now use the intercept term of models fitted with include.constant = TRUE. It was estimated but never read, so point forecasts decayed to 0 instead of to the mean of the process, and simulated series were centred on 0.

  • Fixed seasonal AR/MA polynomial construction in forecast.msarima() (seasonal orders >= 2 placed the coefficients at lags S, S+1, ... instead of S, 2S, ...) and seasonal differencing for D >= 2. The same fix had already been applied to msarima() and msarima.sim().

  • New intercept argument in msarima.sim().

  • Fixed but to order greater then 1 in msarima()

  • Fixed bug to extract the hessian in msarima()

  • Fixed seasonal AR/MA polynomial construction in msarima() and msarima.sim() for seasonal orders >= 2.

  • Fixed seasonal AR/MA polynomial construction (and seasonal differencing for D >= 2) in msarima() and msarima.sim().

  • Initial CRAN submission.

Developed by Daniele Girolimetto, Francesco Lisi, Matteo Grigoletto.
